references.text: Describes how one can chase a thousand and two can chase ten thousand, showing God's power to give victory over enemies.
Joshua reminds the people that one of them chases a thousand because the Lord their God fights for them.
The prophecy that a thousand will flee from the threat of one man, as a contrast to the blessing in Leviticus.
The Lord struck the enemies with confusion and cast large stones upon them, so that Israel's foes fell.
Gideon's 300 men defeated the vast army of the Midianites, showing God's power to give victory with few.
Jonathan and his armor-bearer struck down the Philistines, and the Lord sent confusion among the enemy.
Asa cried out to the Lord, and the Ethiopians were defeated and fell before Israel.
